jobs.descriptionHtml:
HCLTech Jobs 2026 announced for GCP Data Engineers in Noida with 15 openings. Check eligibility criteria, required skill sets, venue details, and apply online.

About HCLTech

HCLTech is a global technology company operating across 60+ countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities in digital, engineering, cloud, and AI. Certified as a Great Place to Work, the organization provides an inclusive, growth-oriented environment for software and data professionals.

Joining HCLTech through the 2026 Hackathon recruitment drive offers exposure to enterprise-scale data infrastructure, complex analytics projects, and continuous career development initiatives.

Vacancy & Role Details

HCLTech is recruiting experienced engineers under its Data Science & Analytics division. Selected candidates will work on scalable data pipeline architectures, enterprise data warehousing, and cloud-native solutions.

Designation: GCP Data Engineer

Total Openings: 15 Posts

Domain: IT Services & Consulting / Data Science & Analytics

Posting Locations: Hyderabad, Chennai, or Bangalore

Who Can Apply?

  • Working professionals with 5+ years of hands-on Google Cloud Data Engineering experience.
  • Engineers proficient in building data pipelines using PySpark, SQL, BigQuery, and Airflow/Dataflow.
  • Candidates available for immediate deployment or with a maximum notice period of 30 days.
  • Applicants willing to relocate to Hyderabad, Chennai, or Bangalore upon selection.

Experience & Notice Period

  • Minimum 5 years to 10 years of hands-on technical experience in data engineering.
  • Notice Period: Immediate joiners to candidates with a maximum 30-day notice period are preferred.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder coordination skills.

Technical Skill Options

Candidates must qualify under at least one of the two skill profiles listed below:

Skill Profile Option 1:

BigQuery

SQL

Python / PySpark

Data Build Tool (DBT)

Skill Profile Option 2:

BigQuery

SQL

Airflow

Dataflow

Dataproc

Python / PySpark

Stipend, Compensation & Employee Benefits

Salary Package: Not disclosed on the initial notice; benchmarked according to industry standards for experienced data engineers.

Employment Status: Full-Time, Permanent position.

Benefits: Access to HCLTech global learning resources, comprehensive health cover, structured career path advancement, and flexible collaborative work environments.
